subtopics.name: Bound-state QED and exotic atoms
subtopics.scope: Relativistic, recoil, radiative and finite-nuclear-size corrections to energy levels of hydrogen, helium, positronium, muonic and antiprotonic atoms.

subtopics.name: Atomic polarizabilities and field-induced level shifts
subtopics.scope: Static and dynamic polarizabilities and the Stark, Zeeman and hyperfine shifts of atoms and ions in external fields, including magic wavelengths and blackbody shifts.

subtopics.name: Dispersion forces and Casimir-Polder interactions
subtopics.scope: Van der Waals, retarded Casimir-Polder and resonant interactions between atoms, molecules and surfaces, including dispersion coefficients and thermal or nonequilibrium effects.

subtopics.name: Photoionization and electron-atom scattering
subtopics.scope: Single- and multiphoton ionization cross sections, angular distributions, autoionizing resonances and low-energy electron or positron scattering from atoms and ions.

subtopics.name: Strong-field ionization and harmonic generation
subtopics.scope: Tunnel and multiphoton ionization, above-threshold ionization, rescattering and high-harmonic generation in atoms and molecules driven by intense laser fields.

subtopics.name: Rydberg atoms and dipole blockade
subtopics.scope: Highly excited atomic states, their scaling laws, long-range dipolar and van der Waals interactions, blockade, facilitation and Rydberg dressing.

subtopics.name: Spectral line shapes and pressure broadening
subtopics.scope: Natural, Doppler, collisional and transit-time broadening, line-shape profiles, Dicke narrowing and line mixing in atomic and molecular gases.

subtopics.name: Molecular rovibrational structure and spectroscopy
subtopics.scope: Rotational, vibrational, fine and hyperfine structure of diatomic and polyatomic molecules, including anharmonic potentials, Hund's cases, intensities and selection rules.

subtopics.name: Nonadiabatic dynamics and conical intersections
subtopics.scope: Breakdown of the Born-Oppenheimer approximation, vibronic coupling, geometric phases, Jahn-Teller and Renner-Teller effects, and radiationless transitions in molecules.

subtopics.name: Chemical reaction rates and tunneling
subtopics.scope: Transition-state, instanton, Kramers and Marcus theories of thermal reaction and transfer rates, including quantum tunneling corrections and isotope effects.

subtopics.name: Solvable model systems in electronic structure
subtopics.scope: Exactly or quasi-exactly solvable few-electron models used to benchmark quantum-chemical approximations and exact conditions of density-functional theory.

subtopics.name: Ultracold collisions and few-body universality
subtopics.scope: Low-energy atomic and molecular scattering, Feshbach resonances, inelastic loss, and universal three-body physics such as Efimov states and recombination near resonant interactions.

subtopics.name: Bose-Einstein condensates: mean-field and excitations
subtopics.scope: Gross-Pitaevskii dynamics, Bogoliubov spectra, collective modes, vortices, solitons and beyond-mean-field corrections in trapped Bose gases.

subtopics.name: Spinor and dipolar quantum gases
subtopics.scope: Quantum gases with internal spin degrees of freedom, synthetic spin-orbit coupling, or long-range anisotropic dipolar interactions, including their phases, spin dynamics and roton excitations.

subtopics.name: Strongly interacting Fermi gases and pairing
subtopics.scope: BCS-BEC crossover, unitary Fermi gas thermodynamics, spin-imbalanced and mass-imbalanced mixtures, Tan contact relations and Fermi polarons.

subtopics.name: Optical lattices and Hubbard models
subtopics.scope: Band structure, tight-binding and Hubbard descriptions of atoms in optical lattices, including Mott transitions, superexchange, Bloch oscillations and artificial gauge fields.

subtopics.name: One-dimensional integrable quantum gases
subtopics.scope: Lieb-Liniger, Yang-Gaudin and Tonks-Girardeau gases, their thermodynamics and correlations, and their nonequilibrium dynamics in one dimension.

subtopics.name: Laser cooling and optical forces
subtopics.scope: Doppler, sub-Doppler and sideband cooling limits, radiation pressure, optical dipole traps and magneto-optical trapping of atoms and molecules.

subtopics.name: Trapped-ion motion and entangling gates
subtopics.scope: Motional modes of ion crystals in Paul and Penning traps, Lamb-Dicke physics, sideband transitions and spin-motion entangling gates.

subtopics.name: Coherent atomic media and optical pumping
subtopics.scope: Electromagnetically induced transparency, coherent population trapping, slow light, optical pumping and atomic magnetometry in multilevel atomic ensembles.

subtopics.name: Precision measurement with clocks and interferometers
subtopics.scope: Optical and microwave atomic clocks, atom interferometers, and atomic or molecular searches for electric dipole moments, varying constants and new forces.

subtopics.name: Cavity QED and Jaynes-Cummings models
subtopics.scope: Coupling of atoms or artificial atoms to quantized cavity modes, including vacuum Rabi splitting, photon blockade, and the Rabi, Tavis-Cummings and Dicke models.

subtopics.name: Waveguide QED and collective emission
subtopics.scope: Emitters coupled to one-dimensional or structured photonic continua, including superradiance, subradiance and cooperative scattering in atomic arrays.

subtopics.name: Open quantum systems and master equations
subtopics.scope: Markovian and non-Markovian dynamics of driven dissipative quantum systems, covering decoherence, resonance fluorescence and nonequilibrium steady states.

subtopics.name: Nonclassical light and photon statistics
subtopics.scope: Squeezed, Fock and cat states of light, photon correlations, and multiphoton interference in linear optical networks.

subtopics.name: Cavity optomechanics and radiation-pressure coupling
subtopics.scope: Radiation-pressure coupling between light and mechanical oscillators, covering sideband cooling, optomechanically induced transparency and quantum-limited displacement sensing.

subtopics.name: Quantum metrology and estimation bounds
subtopics.scope: Ultimate precision limits for estimating phases, frequencies and fields with entangled or squeezed probes, with and without noise.

subtopics.name: Nonlinear optics and optical solitons
subtopics.scope: Parametric and Kerr processes, phase matching, harmonic generation, modulational instability, and soliton propagation in fibers and waveguides.

subtopics.name: Photonic lattices and periodic structures
subtopics.scope: Photonic crystals, coupled waveguide arrays and metamaterials, including band gaps, edge states and parity-time-symmetric gain-loss structures.

subtopics.name: Light scattering and plasmonic nanophotonics
subtopics.scope: Scattering and absorption by small particles and nanostructures, surface plasmon resonances, near-field enhancement, and how nanostructured environments modify emitters.

subtopics.name: Beam propagation, diffraction and polarization optics
subtopics.scope: Paraxial and nonparaxial propagation of Gaussian and orbital-angular-momentum beams, diffraction, partial coherence, and polarization transformations.

subtopics.name: Laser theory and resonator dynamics
subtopics.scope: Semiclassical and quantum laser theory, including thresholds, linewidths, relaxation oscillations, mode locking and optical resonator modes.

techniques.name: Sum-over-states perturbation theory
techniques.scope: Rayleigh-Schrödinger and Dalgarno-Lewis perturbation theory for level shifts, polarizabilities and dispersion coefficients, evaluated in closed form or as rapidly converging sums.

techniques.name: Adiabatic elimination and effective Hamiltonians
techniques.scope: Schrieffer-Wolff transformations and elimination of fast or far-detuned states to obtain effective couplings, light shifts, superexchange and two-photon Rabi frequencies.

techniques.name: Lindblad master equations and quantum regression
techniques.scope: Solving Markovian master equations for steady states, decay rates, fluorescence spectra, and two-time correlation functions via the quantum regression theorem.

techniques.name: Input-output theory and quantum Langevin equations
techniques.scope: Linearized Heisenberg-Langevin equations with input-output relations to compute transmission spectra, noise spectra, squeezing and cooling limits.

techniques.name: Bogoliubov diagonalization and linear stability
techniques.scope: Diagonalizing quadratic bosonic or fermionic Hamiltonians and linearizing nonlinear equations about stationary solutions to obtain excitation spectra, instability thresholds and growth rates.

techniques.name: Partial-wave and zero-range scattering theory
techniques.scope: Phase shifts, effective-range expansions and Bethe-Peierls contact conditions to obtain cross sections, bound-state energies, resonance positions and threshold laws.

techniques.name: Born-Oppenheimer and hyperspherical adiabatic methods
techniques.scope: Separation of fast and slow coordinates to obtain effective potentials, nonadiabatic couplings and universal scaling laws in molecules and few-body systems.

techniques.name: WKB and semiclassical quantization
techniques.scope: Bohr-Sommerfeld and WKB approximations with connection formulas to obtain bound-state spectra, tunneling rates, level densities and quantum defects.

techniques.name: Saddle-point and stationary-phase asymptotics
techniques.scope: Asymptotic evaluation of integrals in a large parameter to obtain ionization rates, harmonic cutoffs, diffraction patterns and semiclassical amplitudes.

techniques.name: Floquet theory and high-frequency expansions
techniques.scope: Quasienergy spectra of periodically driven systems, with Magnus and high-frequency expansions to derive effective static Hamiltonians and renormalized couplings.

techniques.name: Electromagnetic Green's tensors and mode expansions
techniques.scope: Dyadic Green's functions and normal-mode expansions to compute radiative rates, Lamb shifts, Casimir-Polder potentials and dipole-dipole couplings near material structures.

techniques.name: Coupled-mode theory and transfer matrices
techniques.scope: Coupled-amplitude equations and transfer or scattering matrices for waveguides, multilayers, periodic media and resonator networks, giving dispersion relations and transmission spectra.

techniques.name: Phase-space and Gaussian-state methods
techniques.scope: Wigner, P and Q quasiprobability distributions and the covariance-matrix formalism, used to quantify squeezing, entanglement and noise in continuous-variable systems.

techniques.name: Quantum Fisher information and estimation bounds
techniques.scope: Computing quantum and classical Fisher information to derive Cramér-Rao precision limits, optimal probe states and optimal measurements.

techniques.name: Landau-Zener and adiabatic passage analysis
techniques.scope: Exactly solvable time-dependent level-crossing models and adiabaticity criteria to obtain transition probabilities and the efficiency of population transfer, as in STIRAP and rapid adiabatic passage.

techniques.name: Variational and Thomas-Fermi mean-field methods
techniques.scope: Gaussian or trial-wavefunction variational ansätze, Thomas-Fermi limits and self-consistent gap equations for ground-state properties, phase boundaries and collective-mode frequencies.

techniques.name: Bethe ansatz and exact integrability
techniques.scope: Exact solution of integrable many-body and impurity models through Bethe equations, giving energies, thermodynamics, excitation spectra and correlation properties.

techniques.name: Angular-momentum algebra and irreducible tensors
techniques.scope: Wigner-Eckart theorem, 3j and 6j symbols, and spherical-tensor decompositions for deriving selection rules, line strengths, angular distributions and tensor level shifts.
